newsitem.title: CUBA: Eight Cuban soldiers killed in road crash.
newsitem.headline: Eight Cuban soldiers killed in road crash.

text.p: Eight Cuban soldiers, most of them officers, and a civilian were killed in a head-on collision between a military bus and a truck in eastern Cuba, state media reported on Thursday.

The national news agency AIN said the accident happened on Wednesday night on a bend on a road between Holguin and Mayari. Twenty injured people were taken to hospitals in Holguin city, 465 miles (750 km) east of Havana.
The agency did not report the cause of the accident.
